reason: The first matched-control preregistration executed the control only if the primary FCE-versus-base gate passed. Because that gate and the attribution comparison use the same held-out prompts, conditional execution would select the attribution test using one of its inputs. Running both arms regardless of outcome removes that avoidable selective-inference concern.

change.details: Always train and evaluate the trajectory-permuted matched control after the primary arm, whether the primary viability gate passes or fails.

scope: Pre-outcome statistical-design correction made before the bank finalized and before either online arm or held-out evaluation began.
